english.title: Fail to prevent consumer from relying on misleading price indication - Consumer Protection Act 1987
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in the course of your business, namely **(..SPECIFY BUSINESS..), having given to consumers an indication which, after it had been given, had become misleading as to the price at which

(A)_[goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..), were]_
(B)_[services, namely **(..SPECIFY THE SERVICES..), were]_
(C)_[accommodation, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ACCOMMODATION..), was]_
(D)_[facilities, namely **(..SPECIFY THE FACILITIES..), were]_

available

(E)_[generally,]_
(F)_[from a particular person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..),]_

when some or all of those consumers might reasonably have been expected to rely on the indication at a time after it had become misleading, you failed to take all such steps as were reasonable to prevent those consumers from relying on the indication

english.notes:
This CJS Offence Code and Offence Wording is OBSOLETE as from 26/05/08. Repealed by Part 1 of Schedule 4 to The Consumer Protection from Unfair Trading Regulations 2008.

(i) Section 20(3) of the Consumer Protection Act 1987 provides that it is immaterial-
(a) whether the person who gives the indication is acting on his own behalf or on behalf of another,
(b) whether or not that person is the person, or included among the persons, from whom the goods, services, accommodation or facilities are available; and (c) whether the indication is or has become misleading in relation to all the consumers to whom it is given or only in relation to some of them.
(ii) Section 20(5) of the Act sets out specific time limits for prosecution. It provides that no prosecution for this offence shall be brought after-
(a) the end of the period of three years beginning with the day on which the offence was committed; and (b) the end of the period of one year beginning with the day on which the person bringing the prosecution discovered that the offence had been committed
whichever is the earlier.
(iii) Section 21 of the Act provides the meaning of the term misleading.
(iv) Section 22 of the Act sets out the application to provision of services and facilities; section 23 the application to provision of accommodation.
(v) Section 24 of the Act provides defences to the offence.
(vi) The local weights and measures authorities have the duty to enforce the provision concerning misleading price indications, section 27 of the Act; they have powers to make test purchases, section 28, and to enter and search etc., section 29 of the Act.

INDICTMENT: A fine.

Three years from the commission of the offence or one year from its discovery by the prosecutor whichever earlier.
